WARNING: No threshold in this file is recommended or optimal. Rows are measurements across a fixed grid on the gold set. Choosing an operating point here would be tuning on the evaluation set.
DISCLOSURE: Gold should_escalate labels on the 160 assisted examples match the Llama pre-annotation on 159 (accepted in a median 0.4s). All-200 curves measure agreement with human-accepted pre-annotation; the blind_human_entered subset (40) was labelled from scratch.
rule: auto-handled at t iff the system auto-handled it AND score >= t; t=0 ignores the score

definitions.coverage: auto-handled / messages the human judged automatable
definitions.false_auto_handle_rate: auto-handled / messages the human judged should escalate
definitions.intent_accuracy_on_auto_handled: intent accuracy on the messages actually answered
definitions.cost_at_ratio: mean cost per message: unsafe auto-handle = ratio, escalation = 1, safe auto-handle = 0

score_notes.model_confidence: self-reported by the generator LLM; uncalibrated
score_notes.intent_confidence: TF-IDF classifier probability, trained on weak labels; not calibrated on gold
score_notes.retrieval_confidence: top fused retrieval score, min-max normalised per query; relative, not a probability
